column1: # IQ2 motion → domain. Labeler: an LLM agent (2026-10-06), from the motion title alone, no other
# input. Domains: economy · politics_law (domestic politics, government, constitution, civil rights, immigration) ·
# foreign_security (foreign policy, war, terrorism, intelligence/surveillance) · science_health (science, technology, health,
# energy/environment) · society_education (education, culture, media, social issues, sport) · religion_ethics (religion,
# morality, bioethics). keyword_check (build.py) flags titles whose keywords suggest a different domain, for spot-checking.
# dev_overlap = near-duplicate of a pilot/dev topic (eval/data/minimal_pairs/pairs.yaml) → excluded from the test set.
